_comment: SPA fallback, but never for asset-looking paths. A blanket /(.*) rewrite made every missing file answer 200 with index.html, so /apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png (which iOS probes by convention) returned HTML from an image URL. Real files are unaffected: Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites. Extensionless paths and dotted slugs like /profile/user.name still reach the SPA.
